Plans & Billing FAQs
What is SparkToro's cancellation policy?
You may cancel your SparkToro subscription or change plans at any time by clicking on the "cancel subscription" button on the My Account->Subscription page. Your paid plan will end on the date of your next billing cycle (i.e. the month or year anniversary of whenever you first paid for your subscription's start). We do not offer refunds for partial use, except in the cases of SparkToro-caused issues with account access or other problems. If this is the case, email us: support@sparktoro.com and we'll look into any troubles you've experienced.
Can I use software to run SparkToro reports?
Yes — we offer two official ways to access SparkToro programmatically:
MCP server — connect SparkToro to ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or any other Model Context Protocol-compatible client. Lets you build audiences and explore section data right inside your AI assistant. Free with any paid SparkToro subscription.
Public API — REST endpoints for building SparkToro into your own software, dashboards, and automations. Credit-metered pricing, separate from your SparkToro subscription.
Outside of those official integrations, we don't allow the crawling or extraction of SparkToro results by bots, scrapers, or unauthorized automated software. We make substantive efforts to detect such queries, and accounts associated with them may be suspended or banned.
How do I switch to a different plan?
You can switch to a new plan at any time by going to the Billing page in your account. Select the plan you’d like to switch to and immediately start using new features.
Can I subscribe monthly?
Yes, Business and Agency can be billed monthly or annually. Personal is annual only. Use the toggle at the top of this page to switch between monthly and annual pricing. Below is what the toggle looks like.
Additional billing questions?
If you have any additional questions, just send an email over to support@sparktoro.com and we will get back to you in a flash.

About SparkToro
SparkToro ® is a software company founded by Casey Henry and Rand Fishkin, based in Washington State, USA. We believe high-quality market research and audience research should be available to everyone, not just tech giants and those with huge budgets.
The Team Behind SparkToro
Casey and Rand, SparkToro’s co-founders, have worked together previously (at Moz), and have had a long friendship, too. We’re excited about working together on this company and have a good feeling it’s going to become something special.
Rand Fishkin
CEO, Co-Founder
Rand runs most of the show at SparkToro. He was formerly co-founder and CEO of Moz, co-founder of Inbound.org, and author of Lost and Founder: A Painfully Honest Field Guide to the Startup World . He doesn’t take himself too seriously, but he does have a bit of a chip on his shoulder, and is deeply passionate about making SparkToro a great company (at least, by his own peculiar standards).
More about Rand Fishkin
Casey Henry
CTO, Co-Founder
Casey lets Rand think he runs most of the show at SparkToro. He was formerly at Moz, Wistia, HubSpot working on Inbound.org, and most recently at Ookla. When not working, he enjoys spending time with his wife and two daughters hiking, camping, and doing anything outdoors.
Amanda Natividad
Chief Evangelist
Amanda works behind the scenes to let Casey, er, Rand run most of the show at SparkToro. Previously, she led marketing for Growth Machine and for Liftopia. Prior to that, she helped build Fitbit's B2B marketing team. She got her start in marketing at NatureBox. She’s a contributor for Adweek, a Le Cordon Bleu-trained chef, and a former journalist.
The SparkToro Mission
We created SparkToro to help people do better marketing. Specifically, we want to assist organizations of all kinds to quickly and accurately identify where their audience spends time and pays attention, so marketing efforts can be better targeted and more effective. We think it sucks that so much of web marketing today is “buy ads on Facebook and Google.” That duopoly makes marketing less creative, less interesting, and less fruitful. It’s great for Google and Facebook’s bottom line, but that’s where the benefit ends.
Our Vision:
Help people do better marketing by making the publications, people, and sources that influence any audience more transparent
The alternative is to help identify other places that deserve marketing investment — not just advertising, but partnerships and outreach, guest editorials and content contributions, authentic endorsements and organic references. SparkToro can help marketers identify the publications and people that influence their target audience. And *that* can help marketers spread their dollars and their efforts more broadly. We’re excited to help solve this problem, and hopefully, to help diversify the kinds of marketing organizations consider.
We’re a Different Kind of Tech Startup
SparkToro’s goal is to be more of a Zebra than a Unicorn . We believe in organic, profitable growth. We’d rather be the best product in our space than the biggest company. We want to delight customers, help everyone in our field do better marketing, give our team great professional lives, and deliver returns to our shareholders… in that order.
Graphic courtesy of The Zebra Movement
SparkToro is not seeking to raise additional capital. We aren’t looking at M&A opportunities anytime soon and we’re not currently hiring.
